Richard ..., the 18th-century inventor of the spinning frame

explanation.surface: Noah was a creative fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: Double definition: the builder of a famous vessel, and the English inventor of the water frame.

clue.text: Touch up some brass

clue.text: Is back with wife number one, though to separate

clue.text: The ebb-tide?
